t: 阿瓦尔人和萨萨尼德人围攻君士坦丁堡,由拜占庭军队在帕特里森·博努斯(英语:Patrician …
te: The Avars and Sassanids besiege Constantinople, held by Byzantine troops under Patrician Bonus.
dz: 阿瓦尔人和萨萨尼德人围攻君士坦丁堡,由拜占庭军队在帕特里森·博努斯(英语:Patrician Bonus)下所持.
de: The Avars and Sassanids besiege Constantinople, held by Byzantine troops under Patrician Bonus.

t: 未来的唐太宗李世民在玄武门之变中伏击并杀死了他的对手兄弟李元吉和李建成。
te: Li Shimin, the future Emperor Taizong of Tang, ambushes and kills his rival brothers Li Yuanji and Li Jiancheng in the …
dz: 未来的唐太宗李世民在玄武门之变中伏击并杀死了他的对手兄弟李元吉和李建成。
de: Li Shimin, the future Emperor Taizong of Tang, ambushes and kills his rival brothers Li Yuanji and Li Jiancheng in the Xuanwu Gate Incident.

t: 阿瓦尔和斯拉夫军队离开对君士坦丁堡的包围.
te: The Avar and Slav armies leave the siege of Constantinople.
dz: 阿瓦尔和斯拉夫军队离开对君士坦丁堡的包围.
de: The Avar and Slav armies leave the siege of Constantinople.

t: 李世民后被后人称为"唐太宗皇帝",为唐朝取而代之.
te: Li Shimin, posthumously known as Emperor Taizong of Tang, assumes the throne over the Tang dynasty of China.
dz: 李世民后被后人称为"唐太宗皇帝",为唐朝取而代之.
de: Li Shimin, posthumously known as Emperor Taizong of Tang, assumes the throne over the Tang dynasty of China.
